label: Elevated serum levels of interleukin-11 and matrix metalloproteinase-9 in myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome.
summary: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is a disease of unknown etiology associated with chronic severe fatigue and neurological symptoms, including dizziness, sleep disturbances, cognitive impairment and pain. There are no reliable blood biomarkers available for ME/CFS, possibly due to the lack of specific pathogenesis, even though Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV) has been suspected.
